description: NaGeSbO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.70 Å. Ge⁴⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-55°. There are two shorter (1.75 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. Sb⁵⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Sb⁵⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Ge⁴⁺, and one Sb⁵⁺ atom. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Ge⁴⁺, and one Sb⁵⁺ atom.
